import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int mod;
    static int[] inv; // will be reused for factorials then integer inverses
    static int[] fac;
    
    static int modPow(int x, int y) {
        long res = 1;
        long base = x % mod;
        while (y > 0) {
            if ((y & 1) == 1) res = (res * base) % mod;
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            y >>= 1;
        }
        return (int) res;
    }
    
    static void fAdd(int[] a, int i, int j) {
        a[i] += a[j];
        if (a[i] >= mod) a[i] -= mod;
    }
    
    static void fSub(int[] a, int i, int j) {
        a[i] -= a[j];
        if (a[i] < 0) a[i] += mod;
    }
    
    static void fwt(int[] a, int m) {
        for (int step = 1; step < m; step <<= 1) {
            for (int start = 0; start < m; start += step << 1) {
                for (int k = 0; k < step; k++) {
                    fAdd(a, start + k + step, start + k);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    static void ifwt(int[] a, int m) {
        for (int step = 1; step < m; step <<= 1) {
            for (int start = 0; start < m; start += step << 1) {
                for (int k = 0; k < step; k++) {
                    fSub(a, start + k + step, start + k);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    static void polyLn(int[] h, int n, int[] p, int[] invInt) {
        p[0] = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            long pi = (long) h[i] * i % mod;
            for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
                pi = (pi - (long) p[j] * h[i - j] % mod * j) % mod;
            }
            pi = (pi + mod) % mod;
            p[i] = (int) (pi * invInt[i] % mod);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            h[i] = (int) ((p[i] + mod) % mod);
        }
    }
    
    static void polyExp(int[] h, int n, int[] p, int[] invInt) {
        p[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            long pi = 0;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                pi = (pi + (long) h[j] * p[i - j] % mod * j) % mod;
            }
            p[i] = (int) (pi * invInt[i] % mod);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            h[i] = p[i];
        }
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int L = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        mod = sc.nextInt();
        sc.close();
        
        int all = modPow(k, L);
        if ((L & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(all);
            return;
        }
        
        // factorials and inverse factorials up to L
        fac = new int[L + 1];
        inv = new int[L + 1];
        fac[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= L; i++) {
            fac[i] = (int) ((long) fac[i - 1] * i % mod);
        }
        inv[L] = modPow(fac[L], mod - 2);
        for (int i = L - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            inv[i] = (int) ((long) inv[i + 1] * (i + 1) % mod);
        }
        
        // popcount array up to L
        int[] popcnt = new int[L + 1];
        popcnt[0] = 0;
        for (int s = 1; s <= L; s++) {
            // equivalent to `popcnt[s ^ (s & -s)] + 1`
            int lowbit = s & -s;
            popcnt[s] = popcnt[s ^ lowbit] + 1;
        }
        
        // bits decomposition of L
        ArrayList<Integer> bitList = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < 31; i++) {
            if ((L & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                bitList.add(1 << i);
            }
        }
        int n = bitList.size();
        int[] bits = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            bits[i] = bitList.get(i);
        }
        int len = 1 << n;
        
        // g and f arrays: index by popcount (0..n)
        int[][] g = new int[20][len];
        int[][] f = new int[20][len];
        
        // fill g
        for (int mask = 0; mask < len; mask++) {
            int s = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if ((mask & (1 << j)) != 0) {
                    s += bits[j];
                }
            }
            g[popcnt[mask]][mask] = inv[s];
        }
        
        // overwrite inv[2..n] with modular inverses of integers (for polynomial operations)
        for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
            inv[i] = (int) ((long) (mod - mod / i) * inv[mod % i] % mod);
        }
        
        // FWT on each row of g
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            fwt(g[i], len);
        }
        
        // temporary arrays for polynomial operations
        int[] h = new int[n + 1];
        int[] p = new int[n + 1];
        
        // for each mask, apply ln, multiply by k, then exp
        for (int mask = 0; mask < len; mask++) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
                h[i] = g[i][mask];
            }
            polyLn(h, n, p, inv);
            for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
                h[i] = (int) ((long) h[i] * k % mod);
            }
            polyExp(h, n, p, inv);
            for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
                f[i][mask] = h[i];
            }
        }
        
        // inverse FWT on row n of f
        ifwt(f[n], len);
        
        long ans = (long) f[n][len - 1] * fac[L] % mod;
        ans = (all - ans + mod) % mod;
        System.out.println((int) ans);
    }
}
